extension_description.message: Sends Safari address-bar searches to your private SearXNG instance, and to a public engine of your choice when it is unreachable.

popup_error.message: The extension background did not answer.

settings_private_url_help.message: Base URL of your SearXNG instance, without a trailing path. Used whenever it answers.

settings_search_path_help.message: Must start with / and contain {q} exactly once.

settings_probe_path_help.message: Path requested to check that the instance is reachable. SearXNG exposes /healthz.

settings_public_engine.message: Engine used when the private instance is unreachable

settings_public_custom_url_help.message: An https URL containing {q} exactly once.

settings_intercepted_engines_help.message: Tick the engine selected in Safari's own Search settings. Ticking all of them is safe.

settings_only_address_bar_help.message: On: a search typed directly on the engine's own page is left alone. Off: every search on the ticked engines is redirected.

settings_error_invalid_url.message: Enter a valid http(s) URL without query string or fragment.

settings_error_search_path.message: The search path must start with / and contain {q} exactly once.

settings_error_probe_path.message: The probe path must start with /.

settings_error_custom_url_placeholder.message: Enter an https URL containing {q} exactly once.

settings_error_probe_timeout.message: Enter a whole number between 200 and 5000.

settings_error_probe_interval.message: Enter a whole number between 1 and 60.
